blurb: Storing, moving and processing data at scale.

about.Databricks: One place to store big data, clean it and query it, built on Apache Spark.
about.Apache Spark: The engine that splits one big job into parts and runs them on many machines at once.
about.Data Lake: Raw files of any shape, kept cheaply as they arrive. Flexible, but messy.
about.Lakehouse: Both in one system: raw files underneath, tidy tables on top, so reports and models read the same data.
about.Data Warehouse: Tidy tables built for reports. Fast, but strict about shape.

blurb: Running code and keeping data on Microsoft Azure.

about.Azure VM Scale Sets: A group of identical virtual machines. Add more when traffic rises, remove them when it falls.
about.Azure Functions: Small pieces of code that run only when something triggers them, like a request or a new file. No server to look after.
about.Azure Storage: Where the data lives: blobs for files, queues for messages, tables for simple records.
